lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Master!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: While I was cleaning the Commander's Room,

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I found a manila folder in the corner.
Did you open it?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Yep.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: At first I thought it was just garbage and was going to throw it out,

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: but when I picked it up, I noticed how hefty it was.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Turns out it was full of books.
Oh, er... you can just put that back where you found it.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Oh,

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: but I already took them all out

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: and put them on the bookshelf.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Technically, they were magazines, not books.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: They're full of good-looking people, too.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: So they should be in a place where people can see them.
No, don't do that!

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: You don't want them there?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: How about I put them on top of your desk then?
Just put them back where you found them.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I would, but I already threw away the folder they were in,

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: so I can't really find a good place to put them.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: I'll just leave them on top of your desk.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: They'll be out in open where you can see them, so you'll be able to find them quickly.
... Right. Thanks.
I need to get back to the Commander's Room, fast.
